summary: Comprehensive frontend-only testing of AquaFinders React static site (EN at '/' and ES at '/es'). All 17 test scenarios from the review request passed. Home, language switcher, header nav (services/process/about/request/faq/contact), 4 service detail pages, services list, process/pricing page, about, FAQ accordion (outer + faq-trigger, one-open-at-a-time, first-open-by-default, Enter-key toggle), contact form (with hCaptcha container, tel/mailto links), request Google Form iframe, gallery (10 images with descriptive alts), sitemap, ES deep links (/es/faq, /es/process, /es/services, /es/contact), SEO head (title/description/canonical/hreflang en+es+x-default/OG/JSON-LD LocalBusiness), a11y (skip-link + mobile-menu-toggle aria-expanded flip at 390px), image integrity (24 imgs, 0 broken across 4 pages), and 404 route all verified. No console errors detected.
critical_code_review_comments: Home page <title> is slightly redundant: 'AquaFinders - Find the best place to drill a water well - AquaFinders' contains 'AquaFinders' twice. Consider trimming to 'Find the best place to drill a water well - AquaFinders'. Minor SEO polish, not a bug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static React site (no backend). Use preview URL https://dbc0a530-ea32-4969-a2cc-20c7269bc59c.preview.emergentagent.com. When testing FAQ accordion, note that outer sections use one-open-at-a-time behavior: after clicking section N, faq-trigger elements inside other sections become non-visible (expected). Filter buttons via `main button[aria-expanded]` and further exclude class 'faq-trigger' to isolate outer accordion. Contact form must NOT be submitted (live Web3Forms). Some ES service-detail bodies intentionally reuse EN text per problem statement.
